WITH germany AS (
    SELECT "lft", "rgt"
    FROM "tabTerritory"
    WHERE "territory_name" = 'Germany'
)
SELECT
    c."name" AS customer_code,
    c."customer_name" AS customer_name,
    SUM(si."base_grand_total") AS total_invoiced
FROM "tabCustomer" c
JOIN "tabTerritory" t
    ON c."territory" = t."name"
JOIN germany g
    ON t."lft" >= g."lft" AND t."rgt" <= g."rgt"
JOIN "tabSales Invoice" si
    ON si."customer" = c."name"
WHERE si."docstatus" = 1
    AND si."is_return" = 0
    AND si."is_debit_note" = 0
GROUP BY c."name", c."customer_name"
ORDER BY total_invoiced DESC;

    strftime('%Y-%m', "posting_date") AS "month",
    SUM("base_net_total") AS "monthly_revenue"
FROM "tabSales Invoice"
WHERE "docstatus" = 1
    AND "is_return" = 0
    AND "posting_date" >= '2026-01-01'
    AND "posting_date" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "posting_date")
ORDER BY "month"

ORDER BY avg_invoice_value DESC

SELECT
    ig."item_group_name" AS item_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sii."item_code") AS distinct_items_sold
FROM "tabSales Invoice Item" AS sii
JOIN "tabSales Invoice" AS si
    ON si."name" = sii."parent"
    AND sii."parenttype" = 'Sales Invoice'
JOIN "tabItem Group" AS ig
    ON ig."name" = sii."item_group"
WHERE si."docstatus" = 1
  AND si."is_return" = 0
GROUP BY ig."name", ig."item_group_name"
ORDER BY distinct_items_sold DESC;
